snippet.title: The Little Land - Early Access Release Date Trailer (Official)
snippet.description:
The Little Land is coming to Early Access on October 16, 2026.

The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and watch as they gather resources and expand their village.

Wishlist on Steam now :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4296120/The_Little_Land/?beta=0

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/nvJtE6BTcV

#videogames #indiegame #newgame #godsimulator
